title: Monk
name: Tolun
description: An aging ascetic from a far-off mountain order, wrapped in tattered robes and the remains of good cloth, who walks toward whatever place is suffering most. He is outwardly still and unfailingly calm, forever instructing others to breathe, to close their eyes, to set their burdens down. What he carries himself he gives away by the handful, and asks for nothing back.
history: In his youth he did a wrong with his own hands, and climbed into the mountains to be unmade and remade. Decades of harsh discipline in the order that took him in gave him mastery of his body and the beginnings of peace, but never absolution. He came down at last to walk where suffering is thickest, on the understanding that a debt like his is paid nowhere else.
summary: An aging mountain ascetic of great discipline and hidden guilt, walking toward the worst places in the world to work off a debt.

appearance.features: Blue tattoos across one shoulder, hands and forearms always bound in wraps

clothing.head: Hooded wrap
clothing.body: Tattered robes over bare chest, wolf pelt at the shoulder
clothing.accessories: Beaded cord, gourd bottle at the hip

notes: Keeps a rigid daily order whatever the circumstances, rising before dawn, eating only before dark, prostrations at fixed hours
Out of touch with the customs, manners, and famous names everyone else takes for granted
Refuses drink and other indulgence, save for measured mouthfuls from his gourd at set times
